claims.claim_text: Marxist Unity Group works towards adopting a minimum-maximum program for DSA.

Marxist Unity Group's proposed minimum program comprises the policies a socialist party would immediately implement upon taking power to establish working-class political rule and begin a socialist transition out of capitalism.
The maximum program refers to a world free of the market, borders, classes, and all other oppressive structures that exist under capitalism, which is communism.
Centering programmatic politics will restore the sense of unity and purpose that socialists enjoyed during the Sanders campaigns.
Marxist Unity Group intends its proposed program to have more ambitious aims than the Sanders campaigns.
Marxist Unity Group proposes a program developed democratically by the entire socialist movement rather than belonging to a single candidate.
Marxist Unity Group would like to make "program acceptance" the basis of DSA membership.
Under Marxist Unity Group's membership proposal, program acceptance would not require agreement with everything in the program.
Under Marxist Unity Group's membership proposal, program acceptance would mean willingness to fight for the program as an expression of the movement's democratically developed aims.
Under Marxist Unity Group's membership proposal, members would have the right to organize for specific program changes at conventions.
Under Marxist Unity Group's membership proposal, members would be free to publicly disagree with majority decisions if they accepted the decisions as legitimate and assisted with implementation.
Marxist Unity Group describes public disagreement with legitimate majority decisions combined with assisting their implementation as democratic centralism.
